title: Origin of a physical memory relaxation scale (blind protocol)
protocol: PHASE A runs all four derivation branches with NO reference to the candidate macroscopic scale. PHASE B loads the comparison target only after PHASE A completes and compares post-hoc.

checks.name: B1_only_planck_time_from_baseline_constants
checks.summary: dim map det=-2 (nonzero => unique solution): the only time from {c,G,hbar} is the Planck time 5.391e-44 s. No macroscopic time is dimensionally reachable from the baseline constants.

checks.name: B1_macroscopic_time_requires_new_dimensional_input
checks.summary: hbar/E is the only route to long times; E is not derivable from baseline constants. New dimensional input REQUIRED for any macroscopic memory scale: energy (or its equivalents).

checks.name: B2_background_candidates_span_no_macroscopic_memory_scale
checks.summary: Background-derived candidates are either Planckian (~1e-44 s) or cosmological (~1e17-1e18 s). None is an independent, universal, non-epoch-dependent relaxation scale; H0^-1 and Lambda scales are epoch-dependent by construction.

checks.name: B3_selfconsistency_cannot_generate_isolated_scale
checks.summary: self-consistency map is homogeneous of degree 1.0: every solution comes in a continuum of rescaled copies, so an isolated tau_eff requires a NEW inserted scale. Self-consistent generation FAILS without additional structure.

checks.name: B4_scale_invariance_not_broken_by_admitted_principles
checks.summary: No admitted principle breaks scale invariance; rho ~ tau^-p survives all constraints. A finite tau_0 requires exactly one new dimensionful input, whose value remains empirical.

checks.name: PHASE_B_no_admitted_candidate_matches_target
checks.summary: best candidate Hubble_time_H0^-1 misses by 2.54 orders of magnitude; every candidate required a new dimensional input beyond {c,G,hbar}. The target scale is NOT derivable.

checks.name: VERDICT_tau0_is_empirical_input_to_GRUT
checks.summary: All four branches negative: B1 Planck-time-only; B2 background scales epoch-dependent and far off; B3 no isolated fixed point without inserted scale; B4 scale invariance unbroken. GRUT currently contains NO mechanism generating its characteristic macroscopic memory time; tau_0 is an empirical structural input.

phaseA.B1_new_input_required: an energy/mass/density/temperature scale (e.g. E, m, rho, T); none is derivable from {c,G,hbar}

B4_scale_free.minimal_scale_breaking_ingredient: one new dimensionful quantity (energy/mass/density/time); its VALUE is not derivable from admitted inputs

verdict: No branch derives a macroscopic memory scale: dimensional emergence from {c,G,hbar} yields only the Planck time; background scales (H0, Lambda, rho_vac) are epoch-dependent and miss the target by orders of magnitude; self-consistent fixed points are scale-degenerate (no isolated tau without an inserted scale); admitted principles leave exact scale invariance unbroken. GRUT has NO mechanism generating its macroscopic memory time -- tau_0 ~ target is an empirical structural input, matching the target only if inserted.
consequences: Banked negative: the characteristic memory scale is not derivable from the admitted GRUT inputs; it is an empirical input at the level of the spectrum itself (same status as N and rho(tau)).
Any future derivation must supply exactly ONE new dimensionful quantity, and must justify its value -- e.g. from a dynamics not yet in the theory.
The single-pole GRUT kernel with tau_0 is now a parametrized effective ansatz: form partly derived (passive simple pole), scale imported.
Next level: either import the scale explicitly and document it as an external input in the hypothesis register, or seek physics beyond the admitted principles to generate it.
